title: Let standing diagnostics use the flat-pilot deadline
summary: A standing capture grows at about 9 s per robot, so a 1024-robot capture projects to about 9500 s against the 6600 s standard bound. The program lead approved the longer deadline for that capture. The flat-pilot profile, 21600 s native and 22000 s supervisor, now applies to standing diagnostics as well as training and evaluation. Probes, tripod runs and throughput profiles keep the standard bound. A test covers the accepted and rejected modes.
next: Run the 1024-robot standing capture under the pilot deadline, create its admission and profile throughput at 1024.
reason: A deadline-profile extension establishes no native result or accepted capability.
